integrity: Self-contained proof with deterministic finite-field consistency checker; exact formulas are proved, not inferred from finite tests.
scientific_limitations: Fixed cyclotomic scaling action only; no classification up to action isomorphism, no arbitrary group-like Taft automorphisms, and no independent proof or publication-priority certification. The N=m case is prior work.
title: Jordan-rank rigidity for Taft-compatible skew derivations of truncated polynomial algebras
